suggested_fix: No fix required. The function checks the result of sockfd_lookup for failure. It requires the socket to be UDP, SOCK_DGRAM and AF_INET/AF_INET6, and it rejects IPv6 sockets that are not v6-only. It checks and sets sk_user_data while holding lock_sock, which prevents races with other encapsulation users. It takes a reference with sock_hold before installing the tunnel callbacks. Every error path releases the lock and the file reference correctly, using sock->sk instead of the reassigned sk pointer.
